title: Streamed signed BSGS on BLS12-381 G1 with batch affine conversion (exact bound, powers unused)

claims.statement: For the BLS12-381 G1 DLOG target T=[s]P0=A_1 with s uniform in 1..r-1, the deterministic classical cold attack in proof.md uses only T (a subset of the auxiliary powers; no other A_i is read) and succeeds with probability (COV-1)/(r-1) > 1/2 >= 0.39 using total work W(n) = (2^40 + 2^15*n + 3*2^126*1585152)/2000 target-group-operation equivalents for every 1 <= n < r, with no number-theoretic condition. At the scoring n = 2^20, W(2^20) <= 2^(1372154/10000) under the protected C=2000, justified by the exact integer inequality T^10000 < 2000^10000 * 2^1372154 for T = 404549455867094585426921389289762816815792128 scalar instructions. Peak storage is below 2^145 bytes; preprocessing is included in total and bounded by 2^(1372154/10000); nonuniform advice is zero bytes. No heuristic assumptions: success is an exact count and all costs are worst-case analytic instruction bounds. This is an analytic construction, not an executed production attack. The streamed signed BSGS design is credited to public submission f888bb9e-1cc3-4be1-bb0a-734722d78885 as provenance only; the BLS12-381 field pricing, coverage and ledger are re-derived self-contained in proof.md, and no prior acceptance or score is relied upon.

experiments.purpose: Bounded stream sorting/intersection, exact coverage, BLS12-381 G1 Jacobian and zero-safe batch normalization against an affine oracle, negative controls and the exact integer ledger; no production timing inference.
